<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/pricing-card.ts -->
<!--
  A plan as a card: name, tagline, price per month, the features, a call to action and an optional slot for more
  actions. Text comes in through `labels`; the plan is data.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Plan, PricingCardLabels } from "./pricing-card.types";

export type PricingCardProps = {
  plan: Plan;
  labels: PricingCardLabels;
  current?: boolean;
  emphasis?: "auto" | "off";
  density?: "default" | "compact";
  billing?: "monthly" | "annual";
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import Badge from "../primitives/badge/badge.vue";
import Block from "../primitives/block/block.vue";
import Box from "../primitives/box/box.vue";
import Button from "../primitives/button/button.vue";
import CardContent from "../primitives/card/card-content.vue";
import CardDescription from "../primitives/card/card-description.vue";
import CardFooter from "../primitives/card/card-footer.vue";
import CardHeader from "../primitives/card/card-header.vue";
import CardTitle from "../primitives/card/card-title.vue";
import Group from "../primitives/group/group.vue";
import List from "../primitives/list/list.vue";
import ListItem from "../primitives/list/list-item.vue";
import Text from "../primitives/text/text.vue";
import Title from "../primitives/title/title.vue";
import { cn, fmtMoney, tpl } from "../utils";

const {
  plan,
  labels,
  current,
  emphasis = "auto",
  density = "default",
  billing = "monthly",
} = defineProps<PricingCardProps>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ select: [id: string] }>();
defineSlots<{ footer?(props: { plan: Plan }): unknown }>();
const stand = computed(() => plan.highlighted && ((emphasis as string) === "auto"));
const yearlyOn = computed(() => ((billing as string) === "annual") && (plan.yearly > 0));
const amount = computed(() => yearlyOn.value ? plan.yearly : plan.price);
</script>

<template>
  <Block
    tag="article"
    :class="cn(
      'flex flex-col gap-8 bg-card p-6 text-card-foreground inset-ring inset-ring-border rounded',
      'flex h-full flex-col'
    )"
    data-slot="card"
    :data-highlighted="(stand ? 'true' : 'false')"
    :data-current="(current ? 'true' : 'false')"
  >
    <CardHeader class="flex flex-col gap-2">
      <Box class="flex min-h-6 items-center" data-slot="badge-slot">
        <Badge v-if="stand" variant="default" size="default">
          {{ labels.popular }}
        </Badge>
      </Box>
      <CardTitle :as="3">
        {{ plan.name }}
      </CardTitle>
      <CardDescription>
        {{ plan.tagline }}
      </CardDescription>
    </CardHeader>
    <CardContent :class="cn('flex flex-1 flex-col', (((density as string) === 'compact') ? 'gap-2' : 'gap-4'))">
      <Group gap="2" align="baseline">
        <Title :as="2" size="4xl" weight="bold">
          <template v-if="(amount === 0)">
            {{ labels.free }}
          </template>
          <template v-else>
            {{ fmtMoney(amount, plan.currency) }}
          </template>
        </Title>
        <Text v-if="(amount > 0)" size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {{ (yearlyOn ? labels.perYear : labels.perMonth) }}
        </Text>
      </Group>
      <Text size="sm" weight="medium">
        {{ tpl(labels.seats, plan.seats) }}
      </Text>
      <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
        {{ tpl(labels.storage, plan.storage) }}
      </Text>
      <List tag="ul" class="flex flex-col gap-2 text-sm">
        <ListItem v-for="feature in plan.features" :key="feature" class="flex gap-2">
          {{ feature }}
        </ListItem>
      </List>
    </CardContent>
    <CardFooter class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
      <Button
        :variant="(stand ? 'default' : 'outline')"
        size="default"
        data-testid="plan-select"
        @click="() => emit('select', plan.id)"
      >
        {{ labels.cta }}
      </Button>
      <slot name="footer" :plan="plan" />
    </CardFooter>
  </Block>
</template>
